purpose: Teach: 賠償/失業/暴力団/ヒトラー/文部省/王朝/満州/殺す

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 損害、本気で、絶対、賠償、絶対、訴訟、絶対、当社、絶対、注視しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Damages, litigation, compensation — I need our company's stance to be crystal clear on this. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Sharp, measured authority. Each phrase lands with weight. Slight pause between key terms. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to. No room for misinterpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、失業、絶対、防止、絶対、当社、絶対、対策、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're actively advancing protective measures for our staff across the board. Thank you for the clear direction.
lines.style: Steady, professional confirmation. Clipped but not rushed. Shows competence without over-explaining. The cadence of someone reporting progress to someone they respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、暴力団、絶対、排除、絶対、当社、絶対、姿勢、絶対、明確にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make our position on industry misconduct absolutely unambiguous. I need it stated plainly. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, deliberate. Emphasis on the first clause. Slower pace to underscore gravity. No softening language — this is instruction, not suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。歴史展、本気で、絶対、ヒトラー、絶対、関連の、絶対、展示、絶対、当社、絶対、協賛、絶対、慎重に判断します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. Regarding the historical exhibition, we're evaluating our involvement carefully given the sensitivity. Thank you for the guidance.
lines.style: Measured and cautious. Slower on the key phrase about evaluation. Shows thinking before action. Respectful, slightly formal — acknowledging the complexity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の、本気で、絶対、文部省、絶対、ガイドライン、絶対、遵守しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: See that we align with Ministry guidelines without exception. There's no flexibility here.
lines.style: Direct and unyielding. Brief. The delivery of someone used to obedience. Slight edge — this is final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外展開、本気で、絶対、王朝、絶対、文化、絶対、所縁の地、絶対、検討しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're exploring international opportunities with careful attention to cultural and historical context in each market. Thank you for the opportunity.
lines.style: Engaged and thorough. Slower on the descriptive middle. Shows initiative while respecting the seriousness. Earnest without being obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 戦前の、本気で、絶対、満州、絶対、地域、絶対、所縁の、絶対、お客様、絶対、大切にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Our customers with ties to these regions — we honor those relationships with integrity and care. It's fundamental to who we are.
lines.style: Serious, with underlying warmth. Measured pace throughout. The language of someone speaking from principle, not just policy. Slight breath before 'integrity'.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、絶対、人を、絶対、殺す、絶対、ような、絶対、暴力的、絶対、行動、絶対、絶対、絶対、ないよう、絶対、教育しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We maintain rigorous training standards to ensure our staff conduct themselves with complete professionalism and respect. Thank you for the clear mandate.
lines.style: Formal, deliberate. Emphasis on 'rigorous' and 'complete.' Shows understanding of the gravity. Professional close — not defensive, but assured.
